episodes.synopsis: A mysterious “gate” appears in Tokyo releasing mythical creatures that wreak havoc. Itami, who is part of a special JSDF unit, helps with evacuations.
episodes.title: The Self-Defense Force Goes to Another World

episodes.synopsis: In the “Special Region,” JSDF is able to push back the enemy army. Itami joins a recon team aimed at forming a friendly relationship with the locals.
episodes.title: Two Military Forces

episodes.synopsis: Itami's 3rd Recon Unit saves an elf from a village attacked by the Fire Dragon. The villagers of Coda decide to flee to safety
episodes.title: Fire Dragon

episodes.synopsis: The 3rd Recon Unit returns to base with the refugees. Tuka, Lelei and Rory use this time to learn more about each other and strengthen their bond.
episodes.title: To Unknown Lands

episodes.synopsis: The 3rd Recon Unit meets Imperial Princess Piña. Itami decides to protect Italica after hearing that Allied soldiers-turned-bandits have attacked.
episodes.title: The Battle of Italica

episodes.synopsis: The 3rd Recon Unit battles the bandits in Italica. The battle changes course when air support arrives. Piña is stunned by the JSDF’s military might.
episodes.title: Ride of the Valkyries

episodes.synopsis: While returning from Italica, Itami is captured by the Empire’s Rose Knights. Concerned about JSDF’s response, Piña makes a proposition.
episodes.title: The Princess's Decision

episodes.synopsis: Piña, Itami and the others visit different government offices for negotiations. Piña is awestruck by the impressive skyscrapers and people of Tokyo.
episodes.title: Japan, Beyond the Gate

episodes.synopsis: Itami hides Tuka and the others in his ex-wife’s apartment. As Piña and Bozes go to the library, Itami meets his old friend, the Minister of Defense.
episodes.title: The Hakone Mountain Night Battle

episodes.synopsis: When operatives from the U.S., China and Russia approach, Rory uses her unparalleled combat abilities to join in the three-way fight.
episodes.title: Despair and Hope

episodes.synopsis: Five months since the war began, the local refugee camp near the Alnus base has become a town. Piña begins peace negotiations with key Empire nobles.
episodes.title: Visitor

episodes.synopsis: A Dark Elf named Yao asks the JSDF to help drive the Fire Dragon from her hometown. She is mistakenly arrested until Lelei volunteers to interpret.
episodes.title: What Would Itami Do?
